notes.title: Lumina Rush is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913620/a18d4daad2a42775265f4d9c07d7b724ad59cf78.jpg[/img]
In Lumina Rush, you play as a simple square. Traverse levels with a large amount of movement mechanics in order to complete them. Refine your path and earn medals based on how fast you beat levels and earn cosmetics.

[h1]🛠 Build Your Own Levels[/h1]
Lumina Rush has its own level editor for you to create crazy levels, upload them and have the world compete on its very own leaderboard

[h1]🎌 Race Your friends[/h1]
After feeling comfortable beating levels on your own, you can verse your friends in two different multiplayer modes Race and Time Trial. Both modes will see who can navigate levels the best!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2872830/Lumina_Rush/


Thank you all for the support in this journey and good luck on those leaderboards!

--

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Stream!
notes.content:
Checkout the demo of Lumina Rush during this week of Steam Next Fest! Play the demo for the first time or experience the new features added specifically for Steam Next Fest! Also take a peak and watch the developer play the game!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Level Editor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913620/51a5a677481bc5b800aa20adc0934432a572cb7e.png[/img]
This demo includes a level editor that allows players to edit and create their very own Lumina Rush level. After your feeling good about the level that you've made, upload your level and have others attempt to beat your level and compete on its very own leaderboard!

[h2]Versus Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913620/503addb95b18aade86c14f40182db293c1623175.png[/img]
Want to compete against your friends on a level in real-time? Well now you can with the versus mode. Create a lobby, have friends join, and compete in real-time to see who can get the best time on a level with a given time limit!

notes.title: Demo is now live!
notes.content: A demo for Lumina Rush is now live! Play through 15 awesome levels and get a feel for the game! Attempt to get the top leaderboard time for set 1-A to be known as a "God Gamer". Deadline for the event ends May 22nd. Good Luck!
